answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the dune queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1868 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the terrace. The ledge index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 81 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
